instruction: See how iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Pro, and iPhone 15 compare on Apple's website

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing three iPhone 15 variants (Pro Max, Pro, and base model). Agent needs to navigate to Apple Compare page and select iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Pro, and iPhone 15. The evaluator parses the URL query parameter 'modelList' and verifies it contains the three specified models in any order.
metadata.verification: Similar task to original - comparing 3 iPhone 15 variants across different tiers. Uses identical evaluator structure with different model names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements in the instruction
Getter (active_tab_url_parse) properly extracts modelList query parameter from active tab URL and splits it into an array
Metric (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares the extracted models against expected values with ignore_list_order support
Expected values (iphone-15-pro-max, iphone-15-pro, iphone-15) are semantically correct and match Apple URL slug format
Data flow is sound: URL parsing → model list extraction → comparison with expected models in any order
Edge cases handled: missing parameters return None (fails evaluation), URL encoding/decoding supported, order-agnostic comparison
Complete coverage: instruction asks to compare 3 specific iPhone models, evaluator verifies exactly those 3 models are in the comparison URL
